quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on building chemistry during training camp
quotes.excerpt: We are just trying to build, build on what we have been doing in training camp.
quotes.quote: We are just trying to build, build on what we have been doing in training camp. It did feel good to get pretty much everyone that was active tonight out there and get some run.
quotes.social_post: LeBron James says the Sixers are focused on building chemistry during training camp after getting most of the active roster on the floor tonight.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the team's ongoing learning process
quotes.excerpt: We are still trying to learn each other on the floor.
quotes.quote: It is a small sample size. We are still trying to learn each other on the floor. We are still trying to put each other in a position to be successful and compliment each other the best way we can on the floor. It is going to take some time, but tonight was a good sample size for us to build on.
quotes.social_post: LeBron James on the new look Sixers roster: We are still trying to learn each other on the floor. It is going to take some time.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the importance of early transition offense
quotes.excerpt: It is always important just to be able to attack offensively before the defense is set.
quotes.quote: It is always important just to be able to attack offensively before the defense is set. Anytime we can get some early transition points or early attacks against defenses that are not set, we have VJ, Tyrese, and JB. We are able to punch gaps, especially if they have a numbers advantage or even a one-on-one advantage. The guys are not going to be able to stay in front of them.
quotes.social_post: LeBron James highlights the transition potential of the Sixers, noting that VJ, Tyrese, and JB have the ability to punch gaps and create advantages before the defense is set.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on playing with new teammates
quotes.excerpt: I was happy to be able to log some minutes with the guys that we have been going at.
quotes.quote: It felt a little different, obviously wearing a new uniform, but the game is the game and the game needs to be played on the floor. I was happy to be able to log some minutes with the guys that we have been going at each other in practice for a week and a half. It was great to finally just go out there and log some time with the guys that we know are not going to be in the fold.
quotes.social_post: LeBron James admits it felt different wearing a new uniform tonight but was happy to finally log minutes with his new teammates.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on adjusting to his new team environment
quotes.quote: Every day is getting better. Obviously, I am going to have some days where things will be better than others, but when I get to the facility, Ronnie's guys definitely help. We have good energy, good spirit, and obviously, the basketball game is what it brings to all of us is a sense of togetherness and fun. It is fun to go to work.
quotes.social_post: LeBron James says he is enjoying the new environment in Philadelphia, noting that the team has good energy and a sense of togetherness.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on Dean Wade's versatility
quotes.excerpt: He fits on any basketball team on the planet.
quotes.quote: He fits on any basketball team on the planet. You have to have guys like that in order to win, but he could play for any basketball team on the planet and he would fit right in.
quotes.social_post: LeBron James is a big fan of Dean Wade, saying he fits on any basketball team on the planet and you have to have guys like that to win.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on his global impact and Nike tours
quotes.excerpt: I saw the impact and I saw my name being said and jerseys being worn.
quotes.quote: I would probably say my first time I went to China on a Nike tour, I think I was either 19 or 20 years old, and I saw the impact and I saw my name being said and jerseys being worn and my shoes being worn all the way on the other side of the world. I saw the impact that I gave to that community in certain cities that we traveled along throughout that tour. That was very eye-opening.
quotes.social_post: LeBron James reflects on his first Nike tour in China as a teenager, calling the experience of seeing his global impact eye opening.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on playing against an aggressive team
quotes.excerpt: I thought we played some pretty good ball.
quotes.quote: I thought we played some pretty good ball. Obviously, the unforced turnovers, given them pick-sixes, a team like that is very active, has a lot of speed, a lot of length. Their job is to get up and pressure you, to try to make you play against the shot clock, obviously, late in the shot clock. Besides the pick-sixes turnovers that we had, we played some really good ball and it is good to go against a team like that.
quotes.social_post: LeBron James says the Sixers played good ball despite unforced turnovers against an aggressive opponent that relies on speed and length.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on adjusting his personal routine
quotes.quote: It is definitely an adjustment. Obviously, I have my routine, but when you go through an offseason, you have to remember what your routine was again. It does not matter how long you have been in it. Thinking about which bus do I remember taking, what was my routine when I got over to the arena, how do I get ready for the game, how was I laying my clothes out, so all that stuff plays a part. I am still getting into the whole everything, on the court and off the court.
quotes.social_post: LeBron James says he is still adjusting to his new routine in Philadelphia, from travel logistics to his pregame preparation.
